description: chiplet_xml_composer test fixture - a small, project-specific interconnect method registry (not IHP's own interconnect_methods.json). cupillar_opt1 mirrors the real IHP SG13G2 Cu-pillar UBM option (PacTech, Table 6.1 Option 1: 35 um opening, 44 um body diameter, 28 um Cu pillar + 16 um SnAg cap) documented in https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/chiplet-spec/blob/dev/examples/interconnect_methods.json - GDS layer numbers here are illustrative, not the real IHP-assigned ones.
